skills.label: Configure cloud environments
skills.desc: Configure cloud environments for Claude Code cloud sessions: network access levels, environment variables, setup scripts, and environment caching.

skills.label: Configure your terminal for Claude Code
skills.desc: Fix Shift+Enter for newlines, get a terminal bell when Claude finishes, configure tmux, match the color theme, and enable Vim mode in the Claude Code CLI.

skills.label: Customize keyboard shortcuts
skills.desc: Customize keyboard shortcuts in Claude Code with a keybindings configuration file.

skills.label: Customize your status line
skills.desc: Configure a custom status bar to monitor context window usage, costs, and git status in Claude Code

skills.label: Fullscreen rendering
skills.desc: Enable a smoother, flicker-free rendering mode with mouse support and stable memory usage in long conversations.

skills.label: Use Claude Code with a screen reader
skills.desc: Set up Claude Code for screen readers such as VoiceOver and NVDA, plus settings for screen magnifiers, reduced motion, and colorblind-friendly themes.

skills.label: Voice dictation
skills.desc: Speak your prompts in the Claude Code CLI with hold-to-record or tap-to-record voice dictation.

skills.label: Escalate hard decisions with the advisor tool
skills.desc: Pair your main model with a stronger advisor model that Claude consults at key moments during a task.

skills.label: Model configuration
skills.desc: Configure which model Claude Code uses, effort levels, extended context, and the auto-compact window

skills.label: Output styles
skills.desc: Change Claude Code's role, tone, and response format with a built-in output style such as Concise or Explanatory, or write a custom style.

skills.label: Speed up responses with fast mode
skills.desc: Get faster Opus and Fable responses in Claude Code by toggling fast mode with /fast.

skills.label: Auto mode classifier request charges
skills.desc: Resolve the Claude Code notice saying this session isn't eligible for auto mode's no-charge classifier requests: what it means, why it appears, and what to do.

skills.label: Choose a permission mode
skills.desc: Control whether Claude asks before acting. Switch permission modes with Shift+Tab in the CLI, the mode indicator in VS Code, or the mode selector in Desktop.

skills.label: Choose a sandbox environment
skills.desc: Compare Claude Code sandbox options: the built-in sandboxed Bash tool, sandbox runtime, dev containers, Docker, and VMs. Choose the right isolation for your threat model.

skills.label: Configure permissions
skills.desc: Control what Claude Code can access and do with fine-grained permission rules, modes, and managed policies.

skills.label: Configure the sandboxed Bash tool
skills.desc: Restrict the files and network hosts Claude Code's shell commands can reach with the built-in sandbox. Turn it on, set the boundary, and fix what it breaks.

skills.label: Customize sessions in self-hosted environments
skills.desc: Customize self-hosted environment sessions with wrapper scripts for per-session credentials, lifecycle hooks, and on-demand runner spawning.

skills.label: Deploy self-hosted environments to production
skills.desc: Run self-hosted runners in production: security hardening, network egress control, git credentials, Kubernetes and Compose recipes, and troubleshooting.

skills.label: Self-hosted environments
skills.desc: Run Claude Code cloud sessions on infrastructure you control: set up a self-hosted environment, deploy runners, and route sessions to your own compute.

skills.label: Self-hosted environments quickstart
skills.desc: Set up your first self-hosted environment: install Claude Code, create the environment, start a runner, and route a session to it.

skills.label: Self-hosted environments reference
skills.desc: Reference for the self-hosted runner and orchestrator: CLI flags, environment variables, and Prometheus metrics.

skills.label: Test self-hosted environments end to end
skills.desc: Verify a self-hosted runner image from CI: dispatch a session with the CLI, read Claude's replies through a Stop hook, and script the full loop.

skills.label: Verify session identity in self-hosted environments
skills.desc: Verify the CLAUDECODESESSIONACCESSTOKEN JWT so services on your network can trust requests from sessions in your self-hosted environment.

skills.label: All settings
skills.desc: Reference for Claude Code settings.json keys: where each one goes, its type and default, and a paste-ready example, with an index of keys.

skills.label: Example settings files
skills.desc: Realistic settings.json files for a developer, a team, and an organization: copy one, keep the keys you want, and change the values.

skills.label: Settings files and precedence
skills.desc: Change Claude Code settings, pick the scope a key belongs in, verify the change, and learn which value Claude Code uses when a key is set in several places.
